stopped.recordEffect: The existing broad route is legally overbroad. Never-charged matters must use a distinct ORS 137.225(1)(c) Option 3 configuration; acquittals must use a distinct ORS 137.225(1)(d) Option 2 configuration; ordinary dismissals must use a separate ORS 137.225(1)(d) Option 2 configuration. The treatments may share one packet family only if each has a distinct governed configuration; they may not resolve to one generic or null packet configuration.
stopped.whyThisRowCannotBeImplementedHere: The record requires three disposition-bound configurations with distinct route identities. This lane holds one route key, not three, and route identity is not in its owned paths. Emitting a single binding would re-record the overbroad treatment the record retires.
